check_isinstance_SupportsCall: check if a Haiku module like Linear is an instance of SupportsCall protocol
check_isinstance_ModuleProtocol: check if a Haiku module is an instance of ModuleProtocol using isinstance
use_Params_type_alias: annotate a function return type with the Params type alias for nested JAX array mappings
use_Initializer_type_alias: annotate a function parameter with the Initializer type alias for JAX array initializers
subclass_StrictProtocol: subclass StrictProtocol to enforce that only Protocol types can extend it
